name: metabolic
description: Datenpaket für Stoffwechselmediziner: Blutzucker, CGM, Medikamente, Körperzusammensetzung
description_en: Data package for metabolic medicine: blood glucose, CGM, medications, body composition

queries.blood_glucose_log: SELECT ts, date, glucose_mmol, glucose_mgdl, meal_context, hba1c, comment, device_id, source FROM blood_glucose WHERE person = :person AND date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY ts
queries.cgm_readings: SELECT ts, date, glucose_mmol, trend, device_id FROM cgm_readings WHERE person = :person AND date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY ts
queries.medications: SELECT ts, date, drug_name, dose_value, dose_unit, route, notes, source FROM medications WHERE person = :person AND date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY ts
queries.body_composition: SELECT ts, date, weight_kg, bmi, body_fat_pct, water_pct, muscle_pct, bone_kg, visceral_fat, metabolic_age, comment, device_id, source FROM body_composition WHERE person = :person AND date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY ts
queries.lab_results: SELECT date, parameter, wert AS value, einheit AS unit, ref_min AS range_min, ref_max AS range_max, status, labor AS lab FROM lab_all WHERE person = :person AND date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY date, parameter
queries.nutrition_daily: SELECT date, kcal, fat_g, carbs_g, protein_g, meal_count, last_meal, source FROM nutrition_daily WHERE person = :person AND date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY date
queries.lab_manual: SELECT date, parameter, kategorie, wert, wert_num, einheit, ref_min, ref_max, labor, status, kommentar FROM lab_manual WHERE person = :person AND date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY date, parameter
queries.cgm_context: SELECT date, cgm_mean_mmol, cgm_min_mmol, cgm_max_mmol, cgm_cv_pct, cgm_tir_pct, cgm_readings_n FROM daily_context WHERE person = :person AND date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to AND cgm_mean_mmol IS NOT NULL ORDER BY date
